results.product_description:
Infant Ventilators with Electronic Manometer.

Models IV-100B; IV-200 and IV-200 SAVI.
results.reason_for_recall: Electronic manometer malfunctions.   Manometer may be illegible.  The alarm for power failure may function only briefly, or not at all.

results.product_description:
PLV-100 Portable Lifecare Ventilator Life support ventilation
The device is intended to mechanically control or assist patient breathing by delivering a predetermined percentage of oxygen in the breathing gas.  Life support ventilation
results.reason_for_recall: Certain PLV-100 ventilators may not trigger a signal to activate third-party remote alarms or nurse call systems upon device failure.
